name: Weapons Reforged
description: A modular overhaul of weapon usability and proficiency rules for the Enhanced Editions and EET. Clears class, race, and kit restrictions from weapon items, provides configurable proficiency minimums/caps, and optionally removes fighting style limits safely.
author: CelestialFury

components.name: Remove All Class-based Restrictions on Weapons (Item Usability)
components.description: Clears class, race, and kit restrictions from all weapon items while preserving alignment restrictions using category-based detection.

components.name: All Classes Can Use All Weapons
components.description: Patches clasweap.2da so every class except Monks has full access to all weapon categories.

components.name: Universal Weapon Options: Minimum 1 Pip
components.description: Enforces a minimum proficiency level of 1 Pip across all weapon categories. Monks and Kensai remain restricted.

components.name: Universal Weapon Options: Minimum 2 Pips
components.description: Enforces a minimum proficiency level of 2 Pips across all weapon categories. Monks and Kensai remain restricted.

components.name: Universal Weapon Options: Minimum 3 Pips
components.description: Enforces a minimum proficiency level of 3 Pips across all weapon categories. Monks and Kensai remain restricted.

components.name: Universal Weapon Options: Minimum 4 Pips
components.description: Enforces a minimum proficiency level of 4 Pips across all weapon categories. Monks and Kensai remain restricted.

components.name: Universal Weapon Options: Minimum 5 Pips
components.description: Enforces a minimum proficiency level of 5 Pips across all weapon categories. Monks and Kensai remain restricted.

components.name: Enhanced Weapon Options: Minimum 2 Pips
components.description: Applies a minimum proficiency level of 2 Pips while respecting and preserving standard class-based restrictions and zeros.

components.name: Enhanced Weapon Options: Minimum 3 Pips
components.description: Applies a minimum proficiency level of 3 Pips while respecting and preserving standard class-based restrictions and zeros.

components.name: Enhanced Weapon Options: Minimum 4 Pips
components.description: Applies a minimum proficiency level of 4 Pips while respecting and preserving standard class-based restrictions and zeros.

components.name: Enhanced Weapon Options: Minimum 5 Pips
components.description: Applies a minimum proficiency level of 5 Pips while respecting and preserving standard class-based restrictions and zeros.

components.name: Max Out the Weapon Style Options
components.description: Removes the default style caps (2/2/2/3) for Two-Handed, Sword & Shield, Single-Weapon, and Two-Weapon styles for all classes except Monks and Kensai.
